title: OL 9 must use a separate file system for /var/log.
check_content:
Verify that OL 9 uses a separate file system/partition for "/var/log" with the following command:

$ mount | grep /var/log
UUID=c274f65f-c5b5-4486-b021-bee96feb8b21 /var/log xfs noatime 1 2

If a separate entry for "/var/log" is not in use, this is a finding.
fixtext: Migrate the "/var/log" path onto a separate file system.
VulnDiscussion: Placing "/var/log" in its own partition enables better separation between log files and other files in "/var/".
